evidence: 202 recorded snapshots replay within 1e-6; the blind A/B 'same game' exit is NOT met.
limits: Simulation port only: the art is visibly different from the original (a blind model judge told them apart 48 of 48 times); Time Trial only (no rival AI). Sound is synthesised in code: strike and race cues plus a speed-pitched engine; M or the menu button mutes.
Meshy-generated models and procedural track art; independent reconstruction of the mechanics, not a pixel-parity or 1:1 port.
Keyboard on desktop (rebindable); on-screen touch controls with auto-throttle on coarse-pointer devices, which also default to the low quality tier and its lighter model set.
Verified in remote software WebGL2 (SwiftShader), not on a hardware GPU.

checks.name: mounts examples port without code duplication
